readable:
Engineering, San Francisco, Full Time
Frontend Engineer

About us

At Worktrace AI, our mission is to empower people to do their best work. Frontier AI labs are developing AI that can free people to focus on meaningful, high-impact work—yet, most enterprises don’t know where to start and are being left behind. We’re building AI that helps teams uncover their best automation opportunities and build those automations.

The role

We are hiring a Frontend Engineer to turn Worktrace AI’s ambitious product vision into reality. In this role, you will wear many hats: ideating, prototyping, and ultimately shipping frontend experiences in cutting-edge AI products. Along with building, you will identify key areas for engineering investment, build the technical foundation as we scale, and lead by example to build a healthy and strong engineering culture.

What you’ll do

- Collaborate with Design, Research and Backend Engineering to build novel AI experiences
- Build beautiful, production-ready desktop and web experiences with React, Typescript, and CSS
- Set talent and culture standards for Worktrace AI’s engineering team

You’ll excel in this role if you

- Have 3-5 years of professional experience as a frontend engineer
- Are proficient with React and TypeScript, or another modern framework with willingness to learn React
- Have developed desktop apps with Electron that interact with system APIs
- Have solid experience with CSS frameworks like Tailwind
- Have a strong sense for clean design, accessibility, and polished experiences
- Love rapidly building user-facing products in a fast-paced environment
- Find joy in delivering AI magic moments to users
- Can convert vague specs into thoughtfully completed features
- Bring strong opinions about frontend architecture, and hold them loosely

Benefits and perks

- Top-of-market salary and equity
- Visa sponsorship
- Lunch stipends
- Generous health and dental insurance for you and dependents
- Unlimited PTO
- 401K

The Team

Our founders are Angela Jiang (CMU PhD), an early product manager at OpenAI and led the launches of GPT-3.5 and GPT-4, and Deepak Vasisht (MIT PhD), a CS Professor at UIUC who has deployed cutting edge AI into industries spanning agriculture to space. Our team are builders that come from Google DeepMind, Meta, MIT, McKinsey, Twitter, Uber, and HPE. Join us.

Backed by the best in AI and Enterprise

We are supported with a $9.4M seed round led by 8VC and Conviction with participation from funds like OpenAI, SV Angel, and Genius Ventures. Our angels include industry leaders, including Mira Murati (CEO of Thinking Machines Lab), Nick Turley (Head of ChatGPT), Logan Kilpatrick (Google DeepMind), and Ranveer Chandra (Microsoft).
